name: HERNAN-ASENSI
bio:
Hernana Sensi is a tattoo artist renowned for specializing in the black & gray style, effortlessly capturing the nuanced shades and intricate designs this technique demands. Clients commend Hernana for their impeccable cleanliness, maintaining a spotless studio environment that ensures a safe and hygienic experience during each session. While Hernana's artistic talents speak volumes, it is the commitment to maintaining a sterile workspace that garners trust and respect from those who choose to get inked by this skilled artist.
